methodology: Separate direct-source vectors; immutable audit cells and ledger unchanged. Full normalized source longitude/latitude and holes in Canvas; optional altitude omitted from two-dimensional display and polar latitude clamped at the Web Mercator limit, with exact originals archived; cartographic tile simplification only at zooms0–4. No temporal interpolation, no inferred intervening validity.
Source-attributed typed overview; not independently reviewed history. Possible annual observation window is not exact event validity.

source.title: Natural Earth 1:50m physical land
source.attribution: Made with Natural Earth. Free vector and raster map data @ naturalearthdata.com.
source.version_discrepancy: The official landing page advertises 4.0.0; the exact downloaded archive declares 4.1.0. This intake pins the archive edition and SHA-256 before processing. The frozen resource limits are unchanged.
source.interpretation: Complete modern physical land context; not historical shoreline evidence or political ownership. Full source coordinates retained, with display-only latitude clamp at Web Mercator limits and deterministic ten-component MultiPolygon grouping. No source component omitted.
